OAT-05/S30.detail: Fail. The Vertex mapper, toVertexConvexError, copies the first line of the provider's error message (up to 300 characters) into ConvexError data.detail (vertex.ts:135). invokeVision throws it on any failure (vertex.ts:168). Both vision()'s runWithRetry (retry.ts:183) and the aiAction wrapper (phi.ts:191-196) pass it on unchanged. ConvexError data always reaches the client, so the photo scans (scanCensusSheet, scanClinicSchedule, scanPriorNote) hand provider-controlled text to the browser. Google error lines name resource paths such as projects/<id>/locations/..., so a project ID can get through, and so can a service-account email or a sentinel if the provider message holds one. The OpenAI batch transcription path also forwards OpenAI's own error.message (apiErrorMessage, openai.ts:19; transcribe.ts:162). An OpenAI 401 echoes a partly masked sk-proj key, and the comment at openai.ts:6-7 says this text is meant to reach the physician. That one is a plain Error, which Convex normally hides from clients on production deployments, so it reaches the client on dev and preview, and on production only if that hiding is off. The Specode email relay does the same with the relay's payload.error (email.ts:42-47), under the same caveat. Clean paths: Bedrock sends only the kind, error name and HTTP status (bedrockErrors.ts:92); SES sends only the HTTP status (ses.ts:123); the live-session path sends fixed text plus the HTTP status (transcribe.ts:105-106). No recorded gap or open question applies.
OAT-05/S30.detailRun2:
This fails because of the Vertex path. Two other paths (transcription upload and the email relay) also pass provider text, and a third (OpenAI chat) probably does.

**Vertex (fail, decided now):** `toVertexConvexError` (convex/ai/providers/vertex.ts:133-135) puts `detail: (err.message ?? "").split("\n")[0].slice(0, 300)` into the ConvexError data. That is the first line of the Google SDK's own error text, up to 300 characters. Nothing in between removes it:
- `invokeVision` throws it.
- `runWithRetry` rethrows it as is.
- `vision()` returns it to the public `aiAction`s `scanCensusSheet`, `scanClinicSchedule` and `scanPriorNote`.
- `aiAction` (convex/lib/phi.ts:191-196) says it rethrows "untouched, so the client still sees the original error".

ConvexError data is sent to the client in full over the WebSocket. So a Vertex message naming the service-account email or the project id (for example a permission-denied message) reaches the client. That is a Fail under the oracle.

**Bedrock (pass):** `toBedrockConvexError` carries only kind, name and status. The comment says "Never the message".

**SES (pass):** `lib/ses.ts` throws fixed text plus the HTTP status.

**Live session (pass):** `transcribe.prepareSession` throws fixed text plus the status.

**Other forwarding paths (also fail):**
- `transcribe.transcribeAudio` throws `new Error(await apiErrorMessage(res))`, which is OpenAI's own `error.message`.
- `email.ts` throws `Specode managed email failed: ${payload.error}`, the relay's own text.
- `openai.ts` `callOpenAI` does not catch OpenAI SDK errors, so the SDK's message goes out unchanged.

These are plain Errors, not ConvexErrors. Convex replaces plain Error text with a generic server error in production deployments, but not in dev. Whether that happens on the UAT deployment is a runtime question.

No open questions or recorded gaps apply. The oracle and the question agree.
OAT-05/S30.physicianImpact: When a photo scan (census sheet, clinic schedule or prior note) fails at Vertex, the browser receives Google's raw error line in the error data. That line can contain the Google Cloud project ID and, in IAM denials, a service-account email, both of which are visible in the network traffic or devtools. On non-production deployments, a failed recorded-audio transcription can also show OpenAI's error text, which can include a partly masked API key. / When a census, schedule or prior-note photo scan fails on Vertex, Google's own error text (which can name the service-account email or the GCP project) is sent to the physician's browser or phone. The client may also show it in an error toast. On a dev deployment, OpenAI and email-relay error text can reach the client the same way.
openQuestions: Does the production Convex deployment hide plain Error messages from clients? That decides whether the OpenAI transcription text (transcribe.ts:162) and the Specode relay text (email.ts:47) reach clients in production. The Vertex ConvexError detail reaches them either way.
Does any client toast print error.data.detail? Showing it on screen is not needed for the fail, because the data is already in the WebSocket frame.

Does the UAT deployment run in Convex production mode, which replaces plain Error messages (transcribeAudio, the email relay, callOpenAI) with a generic server error? ConvexError data, such as the Vertex detail, is never replaced.
Does the client show ConvexError data.detail in a toast, or does it only travel in the WebSocket frame? The oracle treats either as a Fail.
